name: Pinal County formation notices
description: Notices of formation (new LLCs and corporations) published in Pinal County newspapers, collected weekly by the Console agent. Arizona requires the notice in a newspaper of the county of the statutory agent or known place of business (A.R.S. 29-3201, 10-203), so Pinal businesses appear here, not in the Corporation Commission's Maricopa and Pima list. The address is the business's when the notice gives one, else the statutory agent's (address_type).
